Meet Your Photographer

Sajal Ibtehaj — One Story, Three Crafts

Not a boring CV. A person you can trust with your family's most precious day — soft, respectful and completely professional.

Sajal Ibtehaj
FOUNDER • PHOTOGRAPHER • CHEF

Since 2023, Sajal has been capturing bridal, couple and family celebrations across Islamabad and Rawalpindi — handling everything herself, from the first consultation and shoot planning to the final album in your hands. Her style is soft, respectful and family-friendly: no rush, no discomfort, only your day, told beautifully.

Alongside photography she is a BS Accounting & Finance student at Hamdard University Islamabad and an Aspire Program selectee — which is why her pricing is transparent, her dealing is professional, and her promises are kept. She also gives her time to community volunteer work.

Questions

Before You Book

How do I book my date? +

Send a WhatsApp message to 0314 9449079 with your event date and city. Once availability is confirmed and your package is selected, your date is reserved.

Will my photos be posted online? +

Never without your permission. Bridal privacy is Sajal's promise — your photos are shared only if you say yes.

Do you cover cities outside Islamabad – Rawalpindi? +

Yes, coverage in other cities is available. Share your city on WhatsApp and we will confirm the plan with you.

Are there any hidden charges? +

No. Pricing is fully transparent — use the calculator above to build your estimate, and the confirmed price is final.

What is included in the wedding bundles? +

Basic (Rs. 70,000) covers 1 day with photo + video and a 20-page album. Standard (Rs. 130,000) covers 2 days with a cinematic highlight, 30-page album and 1 day of drone. Premium (Rs. 200,000) covers 3 days with full film, 40-page premium album, drone on all days, teaser and reels.

Can I add drone, reels or extra hours later? +

Yes — drone (Rs. 20,000), reels (Rs. 2,000 each), a cinematic teaser (Rs. 8,000), extra hours (Rs. 3,000/hr) and extra photographers or videographers (Rs. 5,000/day) can be added to any booking.
